author: baseline (hand-written)
title: Baseline
changeSummary: Initial strategy: upwind-only wave penalty, no forecast-uncertainty handling, captain weights unchanged.

author: improvement-agent (muse-spark-1.3)
title: All-headings smooth wave penalty
hypothesis: Polars assume flat water; wave added resistance, pitching/rolling, yaw and sail-handling losses reduce speed on all headings once Hs exceeds ~1.5m, larger offwind from roll/yaw control loss. Baseline only modeled upwind pounding above 2m, so reaching/running in big seas and correlated strong-wind cases are systematically overpredicted.
changeSummary: Replaced upwind-only >2m step penalty with smooth all-headings wave penalty: linear in excess Hs above 1.5m with TWA blend (1.0x upwind ramping to 1.5x reaching/running). Corrects large positive bias in 2.5m+ seas and correlated high-wind cases.

author: improvement-agent (muse-spark-1.3)
title: Correct wave heading dependence
hypothesis: Wave added resistance peaks upwind from pitching/slamming and eases offwind where longer following seas allow surfing; v1.1.0 applied larger penalty offwind, causing under-prediction reaching/running and over-prediction upwind in 2.5-3.5m seas.
changeSummary: speedFactor only: reversed TWA blend so wave penalty is strongest upwind (coeff 1.5) and weakest offwind (coeff 1.0) via coeff=1.5-0.5*blend. Base threshold 1.5m and rate 0.065 unchanged. Raises downwind prediction in 2.5-3.5m to remove -0.19kn bias while increasing upwind penalty.

author: evaluator self-test (hand-written, deliberately flawed)
title: SELF-TEST: blanket sea-state slowdown
hypothesis: EVALUATOR SELF-TEST (not an agent proposal): apply a flat 15 % speed reduction whenever waves exceed 1 m, regardless of height, angle or period.
changeSummary: speedFactor replaced by a step function: ×0.85 for any wave height > 1 m. Deliberately crude — expected to over-correct moderate seas and be rejected.
